params.body:
The Contacten tab on Netwerk and step 1 of Bespreken were the same relations twice: the same columns (importance, who carries it), the same context panel, only in a different order. Now there is one list, and it lives where the table works through it.

## Bespreken: step 1 is every relation

- Step 1 is called Relaties and renders `Office\RelationList`.
- The agenda's relations come first, in its order and with its reason ("Enkel Geert draagt ze, hoog belang"), then the rest by number of projects. 30 rows at first, 25 more per "meer laden".
- Search, role, group and carrier filter the list; Relatie toevoegen (with "werkt met") sits above it.
- Each row shows whether it was discussed and opens its context panel in place, with a link to the relation in the graph. Saving the open relation opens the next one still to do.
- "Nog te doen" and "Alles" apply to the list as to the other steps.

## Netwerk: the graph

- Only the graph with its filters and the relation and project panels. Tabs, sections, sort, overview tiles and the add form go from `Office\Network`.
- `?tab=contacten` opens Bespreken; with `relatie=` or `project=` it opens that panel on the graph. Links from Historiek and from the notes no longer pass the tab.

## Plan

`docs/verkennen-en-overdragen.md` (#137) gets a dated note: point 3 is solved this way, so splitting Bespreken into Volgende and Verteld is on hold.

## Checks

333 tests pass, pint clean. New tests: the list's order, reason, filters and "nog te doen"; the old Contacten link; saving the open relation opens the next; loading more and searching.
